'''Oversized cards''' are Decipher Star Wars CCG premiums printed larger than the 63×88&nbsp;mm playing card. The 5×7 show premiums were given for spending $20 at the Decipher convention store, or as Reflections box toppers. They sit beside [[Promotional Foils]] (normal-size tournament foils) and magazine inserts (InQuest Princess Leia, Scrye Boba Fett sticker, InQuest undersized Jawa). This page is the collecting list; Mara Jade's two 5×7s are treated at length on [[Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood]].<ref name="bgg-42">[https://boardgamegeek.com/filepage/33565/star-wars-ccg-complete-card-list-42 Star Wars CCG Complete Card List 4.2], Whaleyland, BoardGameGeek (22 August 2012). Oversized: Hunt Down & Destroy the Jedi and Mind What You Have Learned (Reflections I box toppers); Aurra Sing, Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand, and Mara Jade, Corran Horn & Talon Karrde (spend $20 or more at Decipher Store at conventions); Princess Leia Organa (InQuest magazine insert).</ref>

== Convention 5×7 (spend $20) ==

[[File:Oversized Mara Jade The Emperor's Hand.jpg|thumb|right|240px|[[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] 5×7, signed by [[Shannon Baksa]] as Mara Jade in San Diego.]]
[[File:Oversized Mara Jade Corran Horn Talon Karrde signed.jpg|thumb|right|240px|''•Mara Jade & •Corran Horn & •Talon Karrde'' 5×7, signed by Baksa, Michael A. Stackpole, and Timothy Zahn.]]

Three 5×7 show premiums were given for spending $20 at the Decipher store at conventions:<ref name="bgg-42" />

* [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] (copyright 2000). Same photograph and game text as the [[Enhanced Jabba's Palace]] premium. Star Wars Collectors Archive item 11259 (Duncan Jenkins, 5×7, year 2000).<ref name="swca-11259">[http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11259 Premium Oversize Card, Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand], Star Wars Collectors Archive.</ref>
* Aurra Sing (Episode I Alternate Image). [[Michonne Bourriague]] portrayed Aurra Sing for Decipher.
* ''•Mara Jade & •Corran Horn & •Talon Karrde'' (copyright 2001). Unique among the oversized cards: no normal-sized counterpart. Destiny 3, Power 8, Ability 5, Deploy 8, Forfeit 9, Pilot and Warrior, Force-Sensitive. Lore: "Each driven by a dubious past, these scoundrels now plan for the greater good of the New Republic. Found in the strangest places." The game-text box is blank. Back: Rebel Alliance symbol, decipher.com, starwars.com. Star Wars Collectors Archive item 11260.<ref name="swca-11260">[http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11260 Premium Oversize Card, Mara Jade, Corran Horn & Talon Karrde], Star Wars Collectors Archive.</ref>

Radio Free Decipher (22 June 2001), reported the next day by Yarua on TheForce.net: Decipher would make the group card available at Origins, San Diego Comic-Con, GenCon, Wizard World, and DragonCon so fans could get autographs from Shannon Baksa (Mara Jade), Michael A. Stackpole (Corran Horn), and Timothy Zahn (Talon Karrde). "No Game Text (you'll need room for autographs!)" The three had been shot together when Decipher photographed the individual [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] cards.<ref name="tfn-rfd">[https://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/Yaruas_RFD_Report_622628_72011.asp Yarua's RFD Report (6.22–6.28)], TheForce.net (23 June 2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20150215035122/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/yaruas_rfd_report_622628_72011.asp Wayback, 15 February 2015].</ref>
